body:
The first time I had Sleep Paralysis was after I took a few green scorpions. I'm not sure what was in it (maybe speed, but I never got SP from speed before though) but when it started to wear off I was trying to fall asleep and I was still awake but I couldn't move. I was numb and I could still see everything.
I had to fight to get out of it and normally I have to try to touch something to get out of it, I normally grab onto my fiance then I am able to get out of it, and I cry sometimes cause I never knew what was happening to me. I did know it was from X though cause after I take a lot of it, is when I get them, right when I am about to fall asleep or when I am about to wake up. Well the freaky paralysis' I've had was when I would hear a loud sound  like something's about to crash and I thought it was my brain about to explode, I'm serious...then I saw an evil face like a scary green monster...I freaked out and cried cause it was my first attack of sleep paralysis and I didn't know anything about it...
I freaked out and cried cause it was my first attack of sleep paralysis and I didn't know anything about it...
sometimes I try to see what will happen if I don't try to fight and get out of it, but I get scared cause I think I'll be paralyzed forever it's just so weird.
But the craziest thing is that I even get Sleep Paralysis from Percocet! After I snort it (like 2 or 3 in a day), and I eventually go to sleep, I have these attacks too....so it's not just X cause I get the same SP with Percocet!
One more thing I want to add...After I went to a rave is when I was hearing the loud crashing sound, during my SP...maybe it was damaging my ear drums from the loud music...I always think I hear things after I roll hard or go to raves...maybe cause all the loud music then coming home to quietness....
It's been over a month now I haven't done any I wanna take a break till the next big rave, plus my serotinin needs to rebuild...but I haven't had  SP since!
Lucky for me though I only get it when I party too hard with it. I'm learning moderation, but I still like to have fun and I have quite a high tolerance.
Thx- X*T*C
